public_rationale: Marcus said it remained to be seen whether ChatGPT or reverse image search could reliably identify the sources of generated images, especially for recent or lesser-known works. The claim would be false if, by January 2024, someone had published an evaluation showing reliable performance. I found none. The opposing post's evidence was ChatGPT-4 recognizing nine iconic images, which does not cover lesser-known material. A June 2024 study found GPT-4V agreed with human judges 82.5% of the time on popular characters. That is not perfect, but it falls after the target period and does not test obscure works. No cited source from the period directly records that reliability had not been shown. So the evidence leans toward the claim but does not settle it.
limitations: The claim is a hedge ('remains to be seen'), so it is hard to contradict.
Evidence from the period is thin. The later study is outside the target period and covers popular characters only.
